manifest: STEMwerk experiment/webgpu-ep W6 experimental Windows WebGPU runtime
generator_host: Windows 11 x64, NVIDIA RTX 3060 Laptop + AMD Radeon iGPU (STEMwerk W5/W6 build host)

package.name: onnxruntime-ep-webgpu
package.license: MIT (LICENSE and ThirdPartyNotices.txt shipped inside the wheel)

runtime_dependencies.onnxruntime: ==1.30.0 (base package, from PyPI; the wheel is a plugin EP and does not replace it)
runtime_dependencies.os: Windows 10/11 x64 with a D3D12-capable GPU driver
runtime_dependencies.notes: No manual DLL copying. pip installs all three native DLLs into site-packages/onnxruntime_ep_webgpu/.

source_provenance.w6_consolidated_commit: 4b10ceeb416c5323a6901ed9618f1074a32a748b (branch w6/consolidated-luid-selection in the isolated ORT clone)
source_provenance.tree_identity: git diff 1070be0 4b10cee is empty; the consolidated single commit is byte-identical in tree to the W5 two-commit stack

consolidated.apply_check: git apply --check passed against the pristine control checkout

build.configure_command: python tools/ci_build/build.py --config Release --build_dir C:\stemwerk-w5-local\build\ort-webgpu-luid --skip_submodule_sync --cmake_generator "Visual Studio 17 2022" --parallel 4 --use_vcpkg --update --build --enable_onnx_tests --use_webgpu shared_lib --wgsl_template static --disable_rtti --enable_lto --cmake_extra_defines onnxruntime_BUILD_UNIT_TESTS=ON onnxruntime_ENABLE_DAWN_BACKEND_D3D12=1 onnxruntime_ENABLE_DAWN_BACKEND_VULKAN=1 onnxruntime_PLUGIN_EP_VERSION=0.3.0
build.w6_build_result: INCREMENTAL_BUILD_EXIT_CODE=0, 0 warnings in the incremental log; 5 of 183410 functions recompiled under LTO (only the patched files)

reproducibility.detail: Same source tree (verified identical to the W5 fix commit) rebuilt with the same toolchain produced a functionally equivalent but NOT byte-identical DLL (W6 ee58f6d3... vs W5 b7a1c62...). dxcompiler.dll and dxil.dll are byte-identical to the W5 wheel. Do not claim bit-for-bit reproducibility; functional equivalence is established by the validation matrix below.

validation.clean_install: fresh venv C:\stemwerk-w5-local\venvs\runtime-w6; pip install onnxruntime==1.30.0 + this wheel; no DLL swapping
validation.loaded_dll_proof: in-process psutil memory_maps enumeration proved the loaded module is site-packages/onnxruntime_ep_webgpu/onnxruntime_providers_webgpu.dll with SHA-256 ee58f6d3... in both GPU directions

regressions.first_inference_crash: diag_single_run.py (RTX) and diag_single_run_amd.py (AMD) both PASS on the W6 DLL
regressions.invalid_luid: mismatched LUID rejected natively (INVALID_ARGUMENT); wrapper raises GpuExecutionNotProvenError instead of silently using CPU
regressions.malformed_selectors: '-1', 'notanumber', 2^65 all rejected at the Python adapter
regressions.capability_matrix: 14 entries, schema validation clean, byte-identical regeneration

install_procedure: optional pipeline deps: pip install audio-separator==0.47.0 psutil

verify: python -c "import onnxruntime_ep_webgpu, hashlib, pathlib; print(hashlib.sha256(pathlib.Path(onnxruntime_ep_webgpu.__file__).with_name('onnxruntime_providers_webgpu.dll').read_bytes()).hexdigest())" must print ee58f6d3312d076b02fb8962fdc7bff4f05e1d27d68a345d9fc382a4a21eb1aa
rollback: pip uninstall onnxruntime-ep-webgpu removes the plugin cleanly; base onnxruntime is untouched; the stock upstream wheel can be reinstalled at any time
limitations: Not bit-for-bit reproducible across rebuilds (see reproducibility.detail)
Native webgpu_context_test.cc unit tests are not runnable in the plugin (shared_lib) build mode; equivalent coverage is via the Python-level rejection/reuse/crash tests
Per-PID GPU Engine counters only attribute dense workloads; bursty MDX inference is proven by placement + numerics + audio, physical selection by the dense probe
Native DLL logs contain CI build paths from upstream (N:\_work\1\s\...) in stock code paths
Windows-only LUID option; Linux/macOS behavior unchanged
ffmpeg must be resolvable on PATH for audio-separator's startup check (any static build works; inference itself uses soundfile)
Experimental: not an official Microsoft/ONNX Runtime release; no production STEMwerk integration
